race.comment: EXALTED FIRE (1) is the one to beat after a solid third in a BM56 over 2000m at Naracoorte, and the return to 1600m is no concern given his strong distance record. His NMW1Y run at Strathalbyn had some merit after he was held up near the 300m, so he brings the right blend of fitness and proven mile form. MUMMSIE (5) is the immediate danger after being beaten just over half a length in a BM70 at this track, with the class drop and 1.5kg claim adding to the case, although she has often placed rather than won at around this trip. BODMIN BOY (9) rises from BM58 and BM54 form, but he has been consistent enough, gets weight relief and has a deep record at this venue. MATRON SAMSING (3) also drops from BM70 level after closing off for sixth, beaten a length and a half, and her proven track-and-trip record keeps her firmly in the mix.
